title: Stop defining your future by your current battles. 🔥
paragraphs: Stop defining your future by your current battles. 🔥

You see the smoke, the fire, and the exhaustion. You feel hitting your limit. But God? He sees the victory, the strength you’re building, and the incredible legacy that is birthed out of this exact struggle.

Don't throw in the towel just because you can't see the finish line. You aren't fighting FOR victory; you are fighting FROM a place of victory in Him. Suit up. Your legacy is waiting on the other side of this fight. It’s time to soar. ⚔️🦅
📖 "But those who hope in the LORD will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint." – Isaiah 40:31
👇 Are you ready to walk in your legacy?
